title: localsend/localsend
title_zh: LocalSend 开源跨平台文件分享应用

paragraphs.en: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop
paragraphs.zh: 一个开源的跨平台 AirDrop 替代品

paragraphs.en: LocalSend is a free, open-source app that allows you to securely share files and messages with nearby devices over your local network without needing an internet connection.
paragraphs.zh: LocalSend 是一款免费的开源应用程序，可让你通过本地网络与附近的设备安全地共享文件和消息，无需连接互联网。

paragraphs.en: LocalSend is a cross-platform app that enables secure communication between devices using a REST API and HTTPS encryption. Unlike other messaging apps that rely on external servers, LocalSend doesn't require an internet connection or third-party servers, making it a fast and reliable solution for local communication.
paragraphs.zh: LocalSend 是一款跨平台应用，通过 REST API 和 HTTPS 加密实现设备之间的安全通信。 与依赖外部服务器的其他消息应用不同，LocalSend 无需互联网连接或第三方服务器，是本地通信的快速可靠解决方案。

paragraphs.en: In most cases, LocalSend should work out of the box. However, if you are having trouble sending or receiving files, you may need to configure your firewall to allow LocalSend to communicate over your local network.
paragraphs.zh: 在大多数情况下，LocalSend 应该开箱即用。 但是，如果您在发送或接收文件时遇到问题，可能需要配置防火墙，以允许 LocalSend 在您的本地网络中进行通信。

sents.en: In most cases, LocalSend should work out of the box.
sents.zh: 在大多数情况下，LocalSend 应该开箱即用。

sents.en: However, if you are having trouble sending or receiving files, you may need to configure your firewall to allow LocalSend to communicate over your local network.
sents.zh: 但是，如果您在发送或接收文件时遇到问题，可能需要配置防火墙，以允许 LocalSend 在您的本地网络中进行通信。

paragraphs.en: On Linux, for example with ufw : sudo ufw allow 53317 . With firewalld : sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/tcp , sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/udp , then sudo firewall-cmd --reload .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Linux 上，例如使用 ufw：sudo ufw allow 53317 。 使用 firewalld 时：sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/tcp ，sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/udp ，然后执行 sudo firewall-cmd --reload 。

sents.en: On Linux, for example with ufw : sudo ufw allow 53317 .
sents.zh: 在 Linux 上，例如使用 ufw：sudo ufw allow 53317 。

sents.en: With firewalld : sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/tcp , sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/udp , then sudo firewall-cmd --reload .
sents.zh: 使用 firewalld 时：sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/tcp ，sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/udp ，然后执行 sudo firewall-cmd --reload 。

paragraphs.en: Also make sure to disable AP isolation on your router. It should be usually disabled by default but some routers may have it enabled (especially guest networks). See troubleshooting for more information.
paragraphs.zh: 同时请确保在你的路由器上禁用 AP 隔离。 它通常默认是禁用的，但某些路由器可能启用了该功能（尤其是访客网络）。 更多信息请参阅故障排除部分。

sents.en: Also make sure to disable AP isolation on your router.

sents.en: See troubleshooting for more information.

paragraphs.en: Create a file named settings.json located in the same directory as the executable. This file can be empty. The app will use this file to store settings instead of the default location.
paragraphs.zh: 创建一个名为 settings.json 的文件，将其放在可执行文件所在的同一目录中。该文件可以为空。 应用程序将使用此文件来存储设置，而不是使用默认位置。

sents.zh: 创建一个名为 settings.json 的文件，将其放在可执行文件所在的同一目录中。该文件可以为空。

sents.en: The app will use this file to store settings instead of the default location.
sents.zh: 应用程序将使用此文件来存储设置，而不是使用默认位置。

paragraphs.en: To start the app hidden (only in tray), use the --hidden flag (example: localsend_app.exe --hidden ).
paragraphs.zh: 要以隐藏模式（仅显示在系统托盘）启动应用，请使用 --hidden 参数（例如：localsend_app.exe --hidden）。

paragraphs.en: On v1.14.0 and earlier, the app starts hidden if autostart flag is set, and the hidden setting is enabled.
paragraphs.zh: 在 v1.14.0 及更早版本中，如果设置了自启动标志且启用了隐藏设置，应用程序将以隐藏方式启动。

paragraphs.en: LocalSend uses a secure communication protocol that allows devices to communicate with each other using a REST API. All data is sent securely over HTTPS, and the TLS/SSL certificate is generated on the fly on each device, ensuring maximum security.
paragraphs.zh: LocalSend 使用一种安全的通信协议，允许各设备之间通过 REST API 相互通信。 所有数据都通过 HTTPS 安全传输，TLS/SSL 证书是在每台设备上即时生成的，确保了最大程度的安全性。

sents.en: LocalSend uses a secure communication protocol that allows devices to communicate with each other using a REST API.
sents.zh: LocalSend 使用一种安全的通信协议，允许各设备之间通过 REST API 相互通信。

sents.en: All data is sent securely over HTTPS, and the TLS/SSL certificate is generated on the fly on each device, ensuring maximum security.
sents.zh: 所有数据都通过 HTTPS 安全传输，TLS/SSL 证书是在每台设备上即时生成的，确保了最大程度的安全性。

paragraphs.en: For more information on the LocalSend Protocol, see the documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 有关 LocalSend 协议的更多信息，请参阅文档 。

paragraphs.en: LocalSend currently requires an older Flutter version (specified in .fvmrc ) and thus build issues may be caused by a mismatch between the required and the (system-wide) installed Flutter version. To make development more consistent, LocalSend uses fvm to manage the project Flutter version. After installing fvm , run fvm flutter instead of flutter .
paragraphs.zh: LocalSend 目前需要使用较旧的 Flutter 版本（在 .fvmrc 中指定），因此构建问题可能是所需版本与（系统级）安装的 Flutter 版本不匹配导致的。 为了让开发环境更加一致，LocalSend 使用 fvm 来管理项目的 Flutter 版本。 安装 fvm 后，请运行 fvm flutter 而不是 flutter。

paragraphs.en: The LocalSend CLI is a terminal client built on LocalSend Protocol v2. Run localsend-cli --help to see every available option and hotkey.
paragraphs.zh: LocalSend CLI 是基于 LocalSend 协议 v2 构建的终端客户端。 运行 localsend-cli --help 可查看所有可用选项和快捷键。

sents.zh: LocalSend CLI 是基于 LocalSend 协议 v2 构建的终端客户端。

sents.en: Run localsend-cli --help to see every available option and hotkey.
sents.zh: 运行 localsend-cli --help 可查看所有可用选项和快捷键。

paragraphs.en: Use the send command with one or more files, directories, or a mixture of both:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 send 命令发送一个或多个文件、目录，或两者的混合：

paragraphs.en: localsend-cli send report.pdf photo.jpg ./project-backup The command opens the discovered-device list; select the destination interactively and press Enter to start the transfer.
paragraphs.zh: localsend-cli send report.pdf photo.jpg ./project-backup 该命令会打开已发现设备列表；以交互方式选择目标设备，然后按 Enter 键开始传输。

paragraphs.en: To select the destination without an interactive device list, pass its exact alias or IP address:
paragraphs.zh: 若要在没有交互式设备列表的情况下选择目标，请传递其确切的别名或 IP 地址：

paragraphs.en: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " report.pdf localsend-cli send --to 192.168.27.26 report.pdf An alias must uniquely identify a discovered device. An IP address is probed directly over HTTPS on LocalSend's default port ( 53317 ).
paragraphs.zh: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " report.pdf localsend-cli send --to 192.168.27.26 report.pdf 别名必须唯一地标识一个已发现的设备。 IP 地址会直接通过 HTTPS 在 LocalSend 的默认端口（53317）上进行探测。

sents.en: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " report.pdf localsend-cli send --to 192.168.27.26 report.pdf An alias must uniquely identify a discovered device.
sents.zh: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " report.pdf localsend-cli send --to 192.168.27.26 report.pdf 别名必须唯一地标识一个已发现的设备。

sents.en: An IP address is probed directly over HTTPS on LocalSend's default port ( 53317 ).
sents.zh: IP 地址会直接通过 HTTPS 在 LocalSend 的默认端口（53317）上进行探测。

paragraphs.en: To send a text message instead of files, use --text together with --to . Pass - to read the text from stdin:
paragraphs.zh: 若要发送文本消息而非文件，请使用 --text 加上 --to 。 传入 - 可以从 stdin 读取文本：

sents.en: To send a text message instead of files, use --text together with --to .
sents.zh: 若要发送文本消息而非文件，请使用 --text 加上 --to 。

sents.en: Pass - to read the text from stdin:
sents.zh: 传入 - 可以从 stdin 读取文本：

paragraphs.en: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text " https://localsend.org " echo " Hello " | localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text - A single trailing line break is dropped from stdin. Text longer than 64 KB is sent as a .txt file instead. Stdin must be UTF-8 and at most 16 MB; send other data as a file.
paragraphs.zh: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text " https://localsend.org " echo " Hello " | localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text - 标准输入末尾的单个换行符会被自动去除。 超过 64 KB 的文本会改为以 .txt 文件的形式发送。 标准输入必须是 UTF-8 编码且最大为 16 MB；其他数据请以文件形式发送。

sents.en: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text " https://localsend.org " echo " Hello " | localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text - A single trailing line break is dropped from stdin.
sents.zh: localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text " https://localsend.org " echo " Hello " | localsend-cli send --to " Cute Tomato " --text - 标准输入末尾的单个换行符会被自动去除。

sents.en: Text longer than 64 KB is sent as a .txt file instead.
sents.zh: 超过 64 KB 的文本会改为以 .txt 文件的形式发送。

sents.en: Stdin must be UTF-8 and at most 16 MB; send other data as a file.
sents.zh: 标准输入必须是 UTF-8 编码且最大为 16 MB；其他数据请以文件形式发送。

paragraphs.en: Directories are collected recursively. Their selected root names and nested paths are preserved on the receiver. Empty directories are not sent because LocalSend transfers file entries rather than directory entries.
paragraphs.zh: 目录会被递归收集。 所选的根目录名称和嵌套路径会在接收方保留。 空目录不会被发送，因为 LocalSend 传输的是文件条目而非目录条目。

sents.en: Directories are collected recursively.
sents.zh: 目录会被递归收集。

sents.en: Their selected root names and nested paths are preserved on the receiver.
sents.zh: 所选的根目录名称和嵌套路径会在接收方保留。

sents.en: Empty directories are not sent because LocalSend transfers file entries rather than directory entries.
sents.zh: 空目录不会被发送，因为 LocalSend 传输的是文件条目而非目录条目。

paragraphs.en: We welcome contributions from anyone interested in helping improve LocalSend. If you'd like to contribute, there are a few ways to get involved:
paragraphs.zh: 我们欢迎任何有兴趣帮助改进 LocalSend 的人做出贡献。 如果您想参与贡献，有以下几种方式：

sents.en: We welcome contributions from anyone interested in helping improve LocalSend.
sents.zh: 我们欢迎任何有兴趣帮助改进 LocalSend 的人做出贡献。

sents.en: If you'd like to contribute, there are a few ways to get involved:
sents.zh: 如果您想参与贡献，有以下几种方式：

paragraphs.en: You can help translate LocalSend into other languages. We use the Weblate platform to manage translations.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以帮助将 LocalSend 翻译成其他语言。 我们使用 Weblate 平台来管理翻译。

sents.en: You can help translate LocalSend into other languages.
sents.zh: 你可以帮助将 LocalSend 翻译成其他语言。

sents.en: We use the Weblate platform to manage translations.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Weblate 平台来管理翻译。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, you can also contribute by forking this repository and adding translations manually.
paragraphs.zh: 另外，您也可以通过复刻（fork）此仓库并手动添加翻译来进行贡献。

paragraphs.en: The translations are located in the app/assets/i18n directory. Edit the _missing_translations_<locale>.json or strings_<locale>.i18n.json file to add or update translations.
paragraphs.zh: 翻译文件位于 app/assets/i18n 目录中。 编辑 _missing_translations_<locale>.json 或 strings_<locale>.i18n.json 文件以添加或更新翻译。

sents.en: The translations are located in the app/assets/i18n directory.
sents.zh: 翻译文件位于 app/assets/i18n 目录中。

sents.en: Edit the _missing_translations_<locale>.json or strings_<locale>.i18n.json file to add or update translations.
sents.zh: 编辑 _missing_translations_<locale>.json 或 strings_<locale>.i18n.json 文件以添加或更新翻译。

paragraphs.en: Take note: Fields decorated with @ are not meant to be translated; they are not used in the app in any way, being merely informative text about the file or to give context to the translator.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意：带有 @ 装饰的字段不需要翻译；它们在应用中不被以任何方式使用，仅作为关于该文件的信息性文本，或为译者提供上下文。

paragraphs.en: For more information, see the contributing guide .
paragraphs.zh: 更多信息，请参阅贡献指南。
